title.rendered: EXCLUSIVE – Kiierr Daily Hair Growth Products Bundle

content.rendered: Order today and see what our EXCLUSIVE – Max growth bundle can do for your hair! This bundle tackles hair loss from every supplemental angle to improve overall hair health.

excerpt.rendered:
Improves scalp circulation, blocks DHT & promotes hair growth. Includes Saw Palmetto, Horsetail Extract & Zinc formula helps slow/inhibit 5-AR enzyme conversion to DHT (primary cause of hair loss).
  • All natural ingredients
  • Enhanced with Vitamin B-6, Biotin, Folic Acid
  • Ideal for supplementing hair loss or thinning hair regimen
  • Contains Soy & Shellfish
  • Physician Formulated
Sale bundle includes: DHT Blocking Shampoo, Conditioner, DHT Blocking Vitamins, and Biotin Gummies.
